review.title: Game Review
review.beta_hint: This feature is new and may be unstable.
review.description: Replay recorded games through a built-in model and set each of your choices beside the model's ranking. Analysis only: it changes no model and does not touch live play.
review.disclaimer: “AI agreement” only says how far your choice is from the review model's own preference. It is not a win rate, an expected value, or a verdict on right and wrong. The review model is a built-in, moderate-strength model.
review.pause_in_game: Pause while a live game is on (recommended)
review.progress_paused: A live game is on — paused ({{done}} / {{total}}), resumes by itself
review.status_stale_hint: The program version or the model weights changed, so the old review no longer applies and will be redone.
review.detail_missing: This game's review was not found (it may be out of date). Review it again.
review.threshold_hint: A play whose probability under the review model is below this is marked “low model support”. It only means the model rarely makes it — not a bad play, and not an expected-value loss.
review.col_matched: Same as the AI's first choice
review.stats_hint: Decisions with a single legal action, and ones the model did not rank, count toward neither agreement nor mean probability. Each kind is counted apart.
review.verify_desc: A self-check on your own real games on this machine: nothing hidden reaches the model, two runs agree, every declined call is found, and the model's response time while a review runs beside it.
review.verify_logs: Read {{games}} game logs; {{changed}} held tiles the player could not see (must be 0).
review.verify_leak: Leak test: {{games}} games, {{decisions}} decisions. With every hidden tile planted with a real one, the final input the model saw differed in {{bad}} (must be 0); without the censor it would have differed in {{would}}.
review.verify_deterministic: Repeatability: {{games}} games reviewed twice, results identical.
review.verify_passes: Call windows: {{windows}} — passes {{passes}}, calls or wins {{calls}} ({{inLogs}} in the logs; they must be equal), not found {{unresolved}}; the played action was not among the ranked ones {{notRanked}} times.
review.verify_latency: Model call time per decision (with the danger head)
review.verify_latency_note: Median change {{change}} ({{events}} events were worked through by the background review during the measurement, so it was really running). This times the model call inside the program, not the network or the screen; the review thread runs at low priority and pauses during a live game by default.
review.dev_title: Record from when it was built (fixed, not updated)
review.dev_tests: Tests: backend {{backend}}, native_bot {{nativeBot}} and frontend {{frontend}} all pass. The review-specific tests cover:
review.dev_real: Real games (my newest {{games}}): {{decisions}} decisions; {{windows}} call windows — {{passes}} passes, {{calls}} calls or wins, {{inLogs}} in the logs, exactly equal; leak test on {{leakGames}} games / {{leakDecisions}} decisions, {{leakBad}} differed; the queue reviewed {{queueGames}} games in {{queueSeconds}} s.
review.dev_latency: Live latency before / after (one model decision): p50 {{aloneP50}} → {{withP50}} ms, p95 {{aloneP95}} → {{withP95}} ms, max {{aloneMax}} → {{withMax}} ms; the background review worked through {{events}} events meanwhile. The difference is within measurement noise: no slowdown was seen.

settings.title: Settings
settings.keep_running_hint: When on, the window's X no longer ends Mokora: it goes to the system tray and keeps running. Click the tray icon to open it again; to end Mokora use the power button in the game screen or Quit in the tray menu. Ending it during a game asks first.
settings.idle_saving_hint: While the window is minimized or hidden and no account is in a game, the game pages rest to save power. A game in progress is never affected by minimizing, hiding or covering the window.
settings.github_mirror_hint: How app updates and bot installs reach GitHub. Auto tries a direct connection first, then falls back to public accelerator mirrors — for regions where GitHub is blocked. (Chrome for Testing downloads always fall back to a public mirror automatically, regardless of this setting.)
settings.custom_mirror_hint: Optional gh-proxy-style accelerator, tried before the built-in list. Public mirrors come and go — set one that works in your region.
settings.custom_mirror_invalid: Must start with http:// or https://
settings.platform_game_hint: Selects which bridge parses the WebSocket protocol. Saving triggers a capture restart so the new bridge picks up the next session.
settings.capture_mode_hint: MITM proxy needs CA cert + system proxy. Chromium launches a controlled browser — no setup.
settings.capture_mitm_only: This platform has no web client — MITM capture only.
settings.block_telemetry_hint: Drop the game's Aliyun analytics beacons instead of forwarding them, so login stats and device / account identifiers never leave your machine. Many ad blockers already block this host, so a missing beacon is not a sign of a tool. On by default.
settings.ca_dir_hint: Where root certificate / keys are written.
settings.detect_status_initial: Click Detect to scan for installed browsers.
settings.user_data_dir_hint: Leave blank to use the default Mokora profile under your config dir.
settings.appearance_sidebar_hint: When the sidebar is collapsed, peek-on-hover expands it temporarily without pinning it open.
settings.ui_scale_hint: Scales typography, spacing, and controls across the app. Saved locally.
settings.custom_hint: Pick five base colors per mode — the rest of the palette is derived automatically via color-mix.
settings.custom_import_hint: Paste a tweakcn URL (share /themes/<id>, editor /editor/theme?theme=<name>, or registry /r/themes/<name>.json) or the raw JSON body. Overrides every token defined in the source.
settings.unsaved_desc: You have unsaved settings changes. Save them before leaving, discard them, or stay on this page.

autoplay.title: Automation
autoplay.enable_help: When enabled, Mokora performs the bot's chosen action for you, clicking it on the board. Needs the built-in game window or the Chromium capture mode.
autoplay.platform_note: The click-timing settings above apply to Mahjong Soul (autoplay simulates mouse clicks).
autoplay.requires_chromium: Autoplay needs the built-in game window or the Chromium capture mode.
autoplay.hover_delay_hint: Mouse must hover for ≥100ms before mousedown for Mahjong Soul to register a tile click. Lower values risk dropped clicks.
autoplay.verify_input_hint: After clicking, wait this long for the game client to send its own input command. If nothing arrives the click was swallowed and is pressed again. 0 disables verification.
autoplay.click_retries_hint: How many times a swallowed click is pressed again. Retries hold the button longer (and nudge the cursor) instead of repeating the same press. 0 only logs.
autoplay.reload_after_failures_hint: If this many decisions in a row register no input at all, the game page is reloaded and reconnects into the hand. 0 disables.
autoplay.dealer_first_discard_extra_delay_hint: Mahjong Soul plays a hand-sort animation when the dealer is dealt all 14 tiles. Clicks during the animation are dropped. ~2000ms covers most devices.
autoplay.delay_mode_lua_help: Delays come from delay.lua next to the config file, generated with a human-like model calibrated against ranked-game data on first use. Edit it freely — it hot-reloads on save; delete it to restore the default. If the script errors, a built-in model takes over.
autoplay.min_delay_hint: Safety floor for every action: Mahjong Soul needs time to render the UI, and a click issued too early is silently lost. Applies in both modes and cannot be undercut by the script.
autoplay.min_button_delay_hint: Higher floor for chi/pon/kan/ron/skip/riichi buttons — they appear only after the discard animation plus their own pop-in, later than hand tiles. Raise this if buttons are still missing clicks.
autoplay.next_game_room_mode_manual: Choose room and table by hand
autoplay.next_game_rule_hint: "Same as last game" finds the table by the position of the last game's table in the room's own list. The room has to be the one you have been playing in; if it is not (or is locked at your rank), the run stops.
autoplay.next_game_stop_on_rank_change_hint: A promotion (or demotion) can change which rooms you may enter. On, Mokora stops and leaves the screens to you; off, it opens and closes the promotion certificate itself and picks the next room from the new rank.
autoplay.next_game_refresh_profile_hint: After each game (back in the lobby) and whenever the Profile page is opened, Mokora opens the game's own profile window to read the latest statistics, then closes it. Off, it presses nothing and the page shows what it last read.
autoplay.next_game_max_games_hint: Games started automatically since you pressed Start auto play (or since Mokora launched). 0 = no limit.
autoplay.next_game_rest_minutes_hint: After a game, wait this long — counted from the lobby coming back — before queuing the next. Logging in again counts towards it; a page reload pauses it until the lobby is back. 0 = no rest. Clicking the game or starting a game yourself during the rest stops the run. At most 45 (Mahjong Soul disconnects after about 53 idle minutes).
autoplay.next_game_relogins: Log in again after every game
autoplay.next_game_relogins_hint: Back in the lobby after a game, log out and back in this many times (0 = never, at most 3): settings → log out → confirm → pick the route on the login screen → enter the game. The login screen keeps the account filled in, so nothing is typed. If the lobby is not back within a minute, the page is reloaded and the login tried again.
autoplay.next_game_fastest_route: Pick the lowest-latency route when logging in
autoplay.next_game_fastest_route_hint: On the login screen, switch to the route (route-2 to 6) with the quickest connection; on a tie, the lower number.
autoplay.next_game_relogin_hint: Log out and back in once now (on the fastest route when the option above is on). From the ranked room or table list it goes back to the lobby first; in a game it does nothing.
autoplay.next_game_relogin_started: Logging in again — watch the game window.
autoplay.next_game_advance_hint: The last hand's win animation plays before the final standings; a press during it is lost.
autoplay.next_game_confirm_presses_hint: The result screens (standings, missions, rank) are dismissed one press at a time until the client reports it is back in the lobby.
autoplay.next_game_step_timeout_hint: How long each lobby step waits for the client to confirm it worked before retrying once, then stopping.
autoplay.next_game_scroll_hint: How the room and table lists are moved to their top or bottom. Try Drag if the lists do not move.
autoplay.next_game_start_started: Auto play is starting. Watch the game window.
autoplay.next_game_buttons_moved: "Start auto play" and "Log in again" are in the sidebar, and run with the saved settings.
autoplay.warning_desc: Autoplay plays the game for you. Mahjong Soul’s terms of use do not allow that, and your account may be warned or banned. Use it only on your own account and at your own risk. You can switch it to “Off” at any time at the top left of the game screen.
autoplay.next_game_max_games_per_day_hint: Full auto starts no game once this account has played this many today (every game counts, from 05:00, when Mahjong Soul resets its dailies). 0 = no limit; at most 99. You can still start a game yourself.
autoplay.daily_limit_desc: This account has played {{played}} games today (limit {{limit}}). Full auto will not start another game today; you can still start one yourself.

welcome.title: Welcome to Mokora
welcome.body1: Mokora watches your Mahjong Soul games and shows the AI’s recommendation and the deal-in risk beside the game.
welcome.body2: The game is shown inside Mokora’s own window: no separate browser, no proxy or certificate to set up.
welcome.body2_browser: Mokora opens the game in a browser window of its own and reads it from there: no proxy or certificate to set up.

mode.title: Pick a capture mode
mode.chromium_desc: Mokora launches a controlled browser and intercepts WebSocket frames via Chrome DevTools Protocol. No system proxy. No CA cert. Works for Mahjong Soul and Tenhou; not for RiichiCity (no web client).
mode.mitm_desc: hudsucker-based MITM. You configure your system proxy and trust Mokora's self-signed CA. Required for RiichiCity (no web client).
mode.embedded_desc: The game is shown inside Mokora’s window, so the whole app is one window and nothing needs setting up.
